Nina K.: FYI found base64 binary fragments in staging backup index (gs://staging-backups/idx-2026-03.ndjson). looks like logged cipher metadata.
Omar (sec): paste sample line?
Nina K.: `...meta:{bin:"QkM0R0FCV1pQbG9k"}, user: 102`
Jules (infra): decodes to 12 bytes. treat as sensitive. I'll suspend backup writes and list affected objects.
AuditBot: detected 5 reads of that prefix in last 14 days; exporting access log to projects/audit-exports.
Omar (sec): immediate plan: 1) remove objects containing those lines (keep audit), 2) rotate svc account keys for backup-agent, 3) create new KMS wrap key and plan rewrap, 4) tighten bucket IAM to group backup-ops only, 5) patch agent to stop logging any binary metadata.
Jules (infra): grep in repo shows debug log: `log.Debugf("meta=%s", b64(meta))` behind DEBUG flag in helm staging values. will flip to INFO and deploy.
Priya (legal): hold external notices until scope confirmed. send me a sample export DM.
Nina K.: running pattern scan across last 120 days now, ETA ~10m.
AuditBot: scan complete: 9 matching objects across 3 prefixes.
Jules (infra): purged latest object versions and opened GCS ticket GCS-7781 to expedite version deletes. changing IAM: removed domain:devs@... and granted group:backup-ops viewer role.
Omar (sec): created new key `wrap-backups-v3` and scheduled rewrap in maintenance window 2026-03-23T01:00Z. also adding CI check to block DEBUG=true in helm values.
Nina K.: posting INFSEC-511 with owners and timeline. will run postmortem once rewrap completes.
Omar (sec): summary: leakage due to debug logging, not crypto key compromise. containment + rotations underway.
Priya (legal): noted for record. closing thread after INFSEC-511 updates.
